method: Fresh Chrome without a user profile. Every published product in EN/JA at1440/390/320 compares all three visible Q&A pairs against independently expanded raw JSON/catalog/JA facts, follows the source-details control and checks footer routing. Six privacy screens inspect inactive status, real external-control hrefs, absence of pretend consent controls, and privacy links. Cookie/local/session storage are checked throughout; each context also inspects IndexedDB/cache/service workers. All external resource requests, page errors and console errors are observed. External settings, merchant pages and applications are not opened. Selected templates use every enabled axe rule. Observed absence of tracking is limited to these scenarios and is not a legal or universal behavior certification.
